title: Lyca Mobile 900GB/365 $220 (75GBper month) @ Lyca Mobile (Usually $480)
body:
Deal: Lyca Mobile 900GB/365 $220 (75GBper month) @ Lyca Mobile (Usually $480)

[bob98] ew vodaphone no wonder i had to google to find it.
[bonezAU] I'm on the 30GB per 30 days annual plan ($150 per year) and when doing a speed test, it bursts to about 400Mbps (providing you're close to a tower) and then throttles back to around 160-170Mbps.
It's definitely not a hard 100Mbps speed cap.
[Think] 75GB/30-Day $220
Very dear for 30 days. 360 days?
[51ngh] $220 spend on Lyca Mobile, let alone $480 ?
No thanks
[scalebearer] Not competitive. Avoid unless you need a large data plan immediately.
Kogan Mobile have routinely put on sale a 900GB yearly plan for $200 multiple times this year.
They give you the full year (365 days) rather than 12 x 30 days (360) that Lyca is offering.
On top of all that, Kogan Mobile allow most of their vouchers to be used for existing Kogan Mobile customers (i.e. keeping the same SIM) and they have a much better reputation than Lyca.
So Lyca want you to pay slightly more, for a plan that lasts slightly shorter, despite their crap reputation, and they don't allow you to buy future discounted plans without porting out and then back in.
[Masticccc] Pretty sure Kogan 900gb is 4G while this one is 5G
[MeesusEff] I just activated my Kogan 900gb plan a few minutes ago, it says the larger plans are 5g
[Masticccc] https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/962637
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/955391
Unless they made changes recently, from previous deals it's 4G.
[jimojr] @Masticccc:
To access our 5G network, you'll need a 5G-approved device, to be in a 5G coverage area and on a Large monthly mobile plan. If your plan only has 4G access, you’ll connect to our 4G network.
So the Kogan Large plan can access 5G, as long as you have a 5G compatible device and are in a 5G coverage area.
[Masticccc] @jimojr: the 900GB (or to be exact 500GB + 400GB bonus) is 4G from the previous deals I linked above, you can check it. It's extra large plan, not large plan btw.
https://www.koganmobile.com.au/legal/
The link above for CIS also said this for extra plan, kinda weird they only have 24 months plan not 365 for extra large:
"The service provided is a Kogan Mobile EXTRA LARGE – 24 MONTH Plan giving access to Vodafone 3G & 4G
coverage"

[bonezAU] They dropped that a long time ago. I've called several 13/1300 and 1800 numbers without any issue, all included in the monthly/annual fee.
[c64] it's in the CIS which is cited for the plan
[bonezAU] It's also in the CIS for the medium plan (which I am on) and probably in the CIS for all their other plans too. Prior to committing to 12 months with them, I bought a 28-day burner Lyca SIM for $10 - that was a few months ago. That also didn't have any 13/18 number restrictions, I was able to call freely as much as I wanted.
I think they need to update their CIS.
The whole MMS thing doesn't bother me either, there's RCS and every other instant messaging platform around that I can use to send people pictures.
